image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a wooden wall-mounted instrument featuring two circular dials stacked vertically. The top dial appears to be a thermometer or hygrometer with a white face and black markings, while the bottom dial is clearly a barometer with a brass/gold rim, glass cover, and visible needle pointing to pressure readings. The casing is made of polished wood.
